summary: Persist minimal duplicate-protection and reconciliation state
description: Prerequisites: T001-contracts and T005-todoist-api. Implement a user-only local store for hashed source identity, stable request UUID, delivery state, timestamps, and confirmed Todoist task ID.
acceptance: The store contains no subject, sender, body, token, description, or raw API payload and uses restrictive file permissions.
Crash, confirmed replay, uncertain delivery, corruption, and concurrent invocation tests prevent a second POST until reconciliation permits it.
